execution.workflow: Mini-ORIGIN Final Fresh OpenML Gate v0.88

primary_failure.stage: frozen OpenML metadata eligibility and raw-byte hash lock before blind record parsing
primary_failure.error: only 5 eligible hash-locked OpenML datasets; required 7
primary_failure.classification: protocol/source incompatibility before the preregistered seven-dataset suite could be formed

workflow_postmortem.cause: the hash-lock and reference shell pipelines used tee without pipefail, so the pipeline exit code came from tee rather than Python
workflow_postmortem.downstream_rust_failure: the compiled Rust replay then attempted to open results/v88/states.txt, which did not exist, and panicked with a missing-file error
workflow_postmortem.interpretation: the Rust failure is downstream infrastructure fallout and is not evidence against the frozen Mini-ORIGIN solver

claim_boundary.allowed_interpretation: negative protocol evidence only: the frozen v0.88 OpenML selection/byte-lock contract could not produce the preregistered seven-dataset suite, so the scientific blind gate was never reached

integrity_decision.future_work_rule: Any further external experiment must be a newly named and preregistered protocol with an explicit new claim boundary. It must not be presented as an untouched repair or successful completion of this v0.88 gate.
